## [epiaware.org](https://epiaware.org)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
- Composable tools for infectious disease modelling in Julia
- Models built from interchangeable parts, not one system rebuilt for
  each outbreak
- A specialist contributes the part they know, without holding the whole
  model in their head
- Uncertainty carried from the priors through infection dynamics to
  observation
- Nowcasting, forecasting and scenarios from one model definition
:::
